title: Practice 2: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Stones were being connected along the lines like beads on a string.
exercises.why: **сходились** — past tense (plural) of сходиться: imperfective (perfective partner: сойтись).  Prefix **с-, со- (+сь, +ся)**: convergent movement from various directions towards one center (в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The priceless china shattered into fragments.
exercises.why: **разлетелся** — past tense (masculine) of разлететься: perfective (imperfective partner: разлетаться).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).

exercises.q: She wanted to get away from everyday life.
exercises.why: **сбежать** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: сбегать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
